reviews.author: BeverlyN

reviews.title: OK for the price
reviews.comment:
This is an okay product for the cost.  I just needed a second screen to make some of my spreadsheet work easier.  The screen comes with three cords.  It would be better if it could be powered through the connection to the computer as the power cord requires an adaptor to plug into a regular receptacle which is not provided. There are two cords for connecting to the computer which gives you a choice of USB or HDMI.  Needing two cords, one for power and one for the connection to the computer, creates a cord mess on the desk.

I'm not a techie person and it wasn't a plug and play device.  I needed to watch videos online to get the Glance to talk to my computer and to set up the mouse to be able to go between the two screens.  Neither were hard fixes, but one more step in set up and those directions were not included in the start up 4 step directions.
reviews.author: LoriW

reviews.title: Great form factor and quality
reviews.comment: True plug and play is awesome and it really pops out of the box. I immediately can tell this is exactly what I needed to boost my productivity in law school and I should.be able to convince my wife to use it on her studies too
reviews.author: Jdcar900

reviews.title: Good second monitor for travel
reviews.comment: The Glance 16" monitor is a great portable second display for a laptop user. I had almost forgotten how much better non-reflective matte screens are compared to glossy glass finishes. The screen seemed kind of out of tune at the default settings. After bumping the back lighting up to full power and selecting cool temperature mode, the display looks great. It powers through my laptop usb-C thus requiring only one cable. The unit is very thin and lightweight. Unfortunately,  the speaker sound quality is horrible thus reducing my rating to four stars
reviews.author: ChrisC
